description: Mobile responsive polish: MobileNav bottom tab bar, responsive DataTable (card view on mobile), AppShell/Sidebar/TopNav mobile improvements, PWA manifest, SVG icons, and touch-friendly updates
steps: Create src/components/layout/MobileNav.tsx - bottom tab bar with Dashboard, Inventory, CRM, Sales, AI tabs. Active tab gets emerald underline. Glass background with backdrop-blur. Only shown on screens < 768px. Hides on scroll down, shows on scroll up
Add MobileNav to src/components/layout/AppShell.tsx (rendered at bottom, visible only on mobile)

Update src/components/layout/TopNav.tsx for mobile: simplified layout with hamburger + title + notifications + avatar on small screens. Search moves to full-screen overlay on mobile. Branch switcher moves into mobile menu

Update src/components/shared/DataTable.tsx to be responsive: mobile (<768px) shows card list view (stacked layout), tablet shows horizontal scroll with sticky first column, desktop shows full table. Use useMediaQuery hook for breakpoint detection

Create public/manifest.json with PWA config: name StockFlow, short_name StockFlow, description 'Enterprise Inventory & CRM Management', start_url '/', display standalone, background_color #0a0a0a, theme_color #10b981, icons array with 192 and 512 SVG icons
Create public/icons/icon-192.svg - emerald SF monogram on dark circular background (192x192 viewBox)
Create public/icons/icon-512.svg - same emerald SF monogram on dark circular background (512x512 viewBox)

Update index.html: add manifest link, theme-color meta tag (#10b981), apple-mobile-web-app-capable meta tag, apple-mobile-web-app-status-bar-style meta tag, og:title/og:description/og:type meta tags for link previews
Add mobile-specific CSS to src/index.css: safe area padding for phones with gesture bars (env(safe-area-inset-bottom)), min tap target size utility (min-h-[44px] min-w-[44px])
Update src/index.css bento-grid to be single column on mobile (< 640px), 2 columns on tablet (640-1024px), 4 columns on desktop
acceptance_criteria: MobileNav component renders bottom tab bar with 5 tabs on mobile viewport
DataTable shows card layout on mobile, full table on desktop
PWA manifest.json exists with correct configuration
SVG icons exist at public/icons/icon-192.svg and public/icons/icon-512.svg
index.html has manifest link and mobile meta tags
pnpm build passes with zero TypeScript errors
findings: Build passes cleanly. TopNav removed Bot icon import (unused after BranchSwitcher repositioning). The isTablet variable in DataTable uses tailwind-style sticky column approach via className strings. Vite chunk size warnings remain for BarcodeScanner and charts bundles (pre-existing, not related to this feature).
